name: Alfonso Higareda
bio:
Immerse yourself in the creative realm of Alfonso Higareda's tattoo studio, a California haven where bespoke inking takes center stage. Specializing in striking black & gray, vibrant new school, and the bold, collage-inspired trashpolka style, Alfonso's mastery transforms skin into a canvas that tells a unique story. With the studio's doors open by appointment only, each piece is a carefully crafted, personal expression of art. Follow @harte_ponxo to witness the artistic journey that awaits at Alfonso's exclusive sanctuary of tattoo artistry.
